objectives: Develop an intelligent inventory management and replenishment system to maintain optimal stock levels across multiple stores.

Minimize stockouts and overstock situations by leveraging historical sales data and predictive analytics for demand forecasting and generating replenishment recommendations (MVP will focus on recommendations for manual review).
Improve product availability, reduce waste, and optimize supply chain efficiency.
Empower store managers and supply chain teams with actionable insights and intuitive tools for monitoring inventory performance and intervention.
dependencies: Forecasting depends on historical sales data, which will require significant cleansing and transformation.
Replenishment recommendations depend on forecasting output.
System must account for supplier lead times, delivery schedules, and warehouse constraints.
Discovery and analysis of existing inventory systems' data formats, APIs (if available), and access methods is required for data integration.
Data integration from existing inventory systems, which may require custom development due to unknown API availability.
timeline: The project aims for MVP delivery by Week 15, followed by a pilot store rollout by Week 20. Key milestones include Data Integration (Weeks 1-4 - assumed complex requiring significant discovery), Data Preprocessing (Weeks 3-5 - assumed to include extensive data quality and cleansing efforts), Demand Forecasting Model Development (Weeks 6-10), Replenishment Logic Implementation (Weeks 9-12), Frontend Dashboard Development (Weeks 13-15), System Integration (Weeks 16-18 - assumed complex due to potential legacy systems), Pilot Rollout and Testing (Weeks 18-19), and Final Delivery (Week 20).
